description: Charity API: get one charitable organization supported by eBay for Charity by charityOrgId (from ebay_get_charity_orgs): name, mission statement, description, logo, location, registration ID (EIN on EBAY_US) and website. Supports marketplaceId EBAY_US or EBAY_GB only. Uses an application (client-credentials) token, so EBAY_CLIENT_ID and EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET are enough; no user consent is needed.

charityOrgId.description: eBay charitable organization ID (charityOrgId from ebay_get_charity_orgs)

marketplaceId.description: Marketplace sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header: EBAY_US or EBAY_GB

name: ebay_get_charity_org
